name: Pokemon Shield dual screen
_about: D2 port (2026-10-25): field pages + battle page are a 1:1 port of the approved D2 mockup renderer's geometry (tools/mockup dir_d2/battle_d2/r4/dir_a/kit*), shapes from baked 9-slice tiles (tools/pokemon-sword/bake_assets.py), text in font_fs_72 at scale 4/5/7 (= the mockup's 34/44/56 px). Only live sw.* values are bound; D2 elements without a reader are greyed '—' or hidden. Generated by tools/pokemon-sword/gen_manifest.py -- edit that script, not this file.
